name: topic-filter
description: Hide chosen topics from Claude: listed terms become stable placeholder names (or their lines are dropped) in tool output, prompts, CLAUDE.md, memory and skills before the model reads them.

hideTagged.title: Hide repos tagged on GitHub
hideTagged.description: Your repositories with one of the GitHub topics below drop out of everything Claude reads. Tag one with: gh repo edit OWNER/REPO --add-topic claude-hidden, then run /topic-filter reload.

githubTopics.title: GitHub topics
githubTopics.description: Comma-separated topics that mark a repository as hidden.

hideAnthropology.title: Hide anthropology
hideAnthropology.description: The built-in anthropology pack: ancient Mesoamerican, Andean and Egyptian sites, civilizations, rulers and deities, and anthropology vocabulary.

hideBiology.title: Hide biology
hideBiology.description: The built-in biology pack: molecular biology techniques, cellular processes and anatomical terms.

hideChemistry.title: Hide chemistry
hideChemistry.description: The built-in chemistry pack: chemical elements, named reactions, functional groups and laboratory equipment.

hideCybersecurity.title: Hide cybersecurity
hideCybersecurity.description: The built-in cybersecurity pack: named malware, worms and hacker groups, and security vocabulary.

hideGenetics.title: Hide genetics
hideGenetics.description: The built-in genetics pack: genetic disorders and syndromes, and genetics vocabulary.

otherPacks.title: Other packs
otherPacks.description: Comma-separated names of your own packs (the packs folder under ~/.claude/topic-filter). /topic-filter packs lists them.

extraWords.title: Extra words to hide
extraWords.description: Comma-separated words or names to hide. Kept in secure storage, not in settings.json.

configPath.title: Topics file (advanced)
configPath.description: Optional, for per-list modes and restore lists. Empty means the default file in ~/.claude/topic-filter.
